svg.text: Validation: latest main + #335 file-mutation precondition fix
PASS stale retry after lost mutation response fails closed
PASS edit after divergence is rejected
PASS explicitly empty precondition is rejected
PASS concurrent same-file validation is serialized
#335 prevents a stale retry from overwriting newer file state after an uncertain/lost response.
It fails closed when the original expected-before hash no longer matches.
This does not recover the original lost response or provide an operation receipt.
Actual DevSpace pi-tools.ts was compiled/executed in Node 22; external Pi file tools were minimally stubbed.
Targeted proxy verification, not a full dependency-backed repository CI run.
